_comment: Technology monitoring config. One entry per team member. discordUserId: right-click the user in Discord (Developer Mode on) > Copy User ID. Feed types: reddit (https://www.reddit.com/r/<sub>/.rss), youtube (https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=<id>), github (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/releases.atom or commits/<branch>.atom), newsletter (any RSS/Atom URL). Members whose discordUserId is all zeros are placeholders: their feeds are fetched but nothing is posted.
